annotations.rationale: SwitchMLP router init runs outside DP RNG fork; with TP>1 router weights diverge across TP ranks. Cross-TP-rank checksum equality on router weight (precond: router is DP-replicated). Borderline P3 vs P4: chose P3 — symptom is cross-rank mismatch, not attr read.

First call each global step must observe micro_step_id==0 after the in-step increment; buggy init=0 yields ids (1..gas) on first step. Single counter check, no cross-rank or precond. Borderline gradient_sync vs control_flow: chose control_flow — root cause is counter init / gating, not reduction op.

After clip_grad_norm_, ||grad|| must be <= max_norm. torch.max -> torch.min typo causes coef==1 so clipping never happens. Single-rank value_range check on grad_norm vs max_norm; no cross-rank or precond gating. Borderline P1 vs P5: chose P5 because grad-scale/norm bound is the textbook P5 case.

After AdamWConfig.build, every param_group must contain key 'initial_lr'; missing causes silent LR loss on resume. Set-completeness over param_groups; no cross-rank. Borderline value_equality vs completeness per anti-example 12: completeness — set check, not single value.

Residual must equal original input but block.forward overwrites x with attn_norm(x). Needs op-level forward intermediate (residual identity) — not in Tier 0-6. Source-only per anti-example 9. Borderline P1 vs none: cannot pin to a runtime trace field — pattern=none.

z_loss masked-mean divides by mean(mask) instead of multiplying then taking mean — wrong scalar. Needs op-level loss intermediate vs reference; no Tier 0-6 field flags it. Borderline numerical vs loss_computation: chose loss_computation — bug is in the loss formula, not generic numerical drift.

z_loss divisor uses num_micro_batches instead of batch_size_in_tokens; need to compare against reference computation to flag. Loss scalar alone looks plausible — runtime trace cannot distinguish. Source-only per anti-example 9. parallel_dim=none (single-GPU reproduces).

LinearWithFrozenWeight.backward skips all-reduce of grad_input across TP; per-rank grad_input is 1/N of expected. Cross-TP comparison gated on precond 'weight frozen and TP>1'. Borderline P5 vs P3: chose P3 — signal is cross-rank disagreement, not a magnitude bound.

engine.communication_data_type() must equal bf16 when bf16_enabled and no explicit comm dtype. Single field read gated on precond 'bf16_enabled, not fp16_enabled, no explicit comm dtype'. Anti-example 1: dtype check needs precond guard — schema_topo_precond.

get_data_parallel_src_rank() must equal min(global ranks in local DP group); buggy formula breaks under PP>1. Single value vs config-derived constant; no module attr precond. Borderline control_flow vs communication: chose communication — wrong value is process-group-derived rank, canonical P6.

After finish_grad_sync expert_grads must be scaled by 1/dp_world_size; buggy code skips so norm ratio is 1 not 1/dp_world. Precond: 'param is MoE expert with local-only main_grad'. parallel_dim=combo (DP+EP). Borderline P3 vs P5: chose P5 — norm-ratio bound, not cross-rank equality.

param_sync invocation count must equal total_num_microbatches not num_microbatches under interleaved PP. Single counter vs config-derived constant; no module attr precond. Borderline gradient_sync vs control_flow: chose control_flow — root cause is gating arithmetic, not a sync-op error.

FlashSelfAttention.dropout_p must equal constructor value before each forward; eval branch permanently mutates it to 0. Single attr read vs constructor constant. Borderline P4 vs P7: chose P7 — attr is a counter/flag, not dtype/shape. parallel_dim=none — single-GPU reproduces.

_create_ep_parallel_group called with num_experts instead of ep_size; EP group size must equal ep_size. Single value vs config. Borderline build vs init: chose init — group construction is deepspeed.initialize() runtime, not static __init__. P6 because comm-group-config check.

On second all2all (scatter_idx<2), kv_heads None, num_heads%seq_world_size!=0, must NOT take uneven path. Branch-flag check gated on multi-attr precond. Borderline communication vs control_flow: chose control_flow — root cause is wrong gate predicate, not collective itself.

PipelineEngine sums grads instead of averaging across GAS — grad-norm grows linearly with GAS for same effective batch. Single-rank grad_norm trended vs GAS reveals it; no cross-rank or precond. Borderline P1 vs P5: chose P5 — magnitude-bound discriminator.

ZeRO-2 backward has a numerical regression that lowers grad-norm by ~half compared with ZeRO-1/3, but absolute grad norm is plausible by itself; only comparison with another ZeRO stage flags it. No runtime trace field can detect without a reference run — source/cross-stage analysis required.

After reduce_scatter, non-target ranks should not retain unreduced local grads on partition-boundary params. Cross-DP-rank grad equality gated on 'param spans a partition boundary' precond. Borderline P3 vs P5: chose P3 — signal is rank-disagreement, not magnitude bound.

DistributedAttention output diverges from local-attention reference when seq_len % world_size != 0. Without a reference implementation run side-by-side, no Tier 0-6 trace can distinguish — output activations are op-level intermediates beyond Tier 6. parallel_dim=SP (sequence parallel).

CPUAdam IncrementStep computes bias_correction2 differently across subgroup calls in same step (std::pow vs mul path). Cross-subgroup scalar equality gated on 'same logical step, multiple subgroups' precond. Borderline P3 vs P7: chose P7 — check is Adam internal scalar, not param checksum.

FusedAdam int32 sizes overflow for >=2^31-element tensors; kernel loop skipped, param checksum unchanged. Pre/post-step checksum diff gated on 'param.numel>=2^31' precond. Borderline P1 vs P7: chose P7 — 'update happened or not' is a flag check conditioned on numel.

fp16 config accepts loss_scale=inf without validation; single-field range check on loss_scale (must be finite positive). No cross-rank, no module-attr precond. Borderline P5 vs P1: chose P1 because the violated invariant is a fixed configured constant range, not an emergent grad-norm bound.

DeepSpeed checkpoint fn incompatible with torch.compile: RNG state save/restore mismatch causes dropout drift over thousands of steps. Loss diverges only vs reference run; no single-run trace field flags drift. Source/long-run comparison required.

ZeRO-3 _register_hooks_recursively overwrites user-set module.id used for expert placement. Detect by snapshotting module.id before vs after deepspeed.initialize, gated on 'module is an MoE expert' precond. Borderline P4 vs P7: chose P7 — the field is a counter/flag attr, not dtype/shape.

ZeRO-1/2 CPU-offload drops mid-microstep grads when ga=1 with multiple backward; params drift ~2x lr from non-offload reference. Cross-rank checksum gated on cpu_offload precond. Borderline P5 vs P3: chose P3 — symptom is replication mismatch vs ref.

BF16_Optimizer calls backward_epilogue after allreduce so last microbatch fp32 grads excluded. Symptom: post-step DP-replicated checksums briefly differ. Precond: 'bf16+grad_accum_dtype=fp32, ZeRO-1, gas>1'. Borderline P3 vs P5: chose P3 — primary signal is cross-rank checksum disagreement.

CPU-offload with gas>1: grad norm should grow with microsteps but freezes after first because mid-step grads dropped instead of accumulated. Precond: cpu_offload=True and gas>1. Single-rank grad_norm trend over microsteps; not cross-rank. Borderline P3 vs P5: chose P5 — magnitude/monotonicity bound.

bf16+ZeRO0: dynamic loss scale=65536 applied without backward-loss scaling shrinks grads catastrophically AND grad-zero is skipped so grads accumulate forever. Detect by grad_norm growth over steps gated on 'bf16+ZeRO0' precond. Borderline P1 vs P5: chose P5 — magnitude/monotonic bound across steps.

Ping-pong buffer index reset causes reduce_ipg_grads to use stale data, but the resulting grad-norm bias is small and within plausible noise; only side-by-side comparison vs overlap_comm=False shows it. detection_method=source_analysis. Per anti-example 9, source-only.

Misplaced 'return self.overflow' makes FP16 optimizer step always exit early — params never update. Pre/post-step checksum equality detects it; source_analysis label but runtime symptom is observable. Borderline P7 vs P1: chose P1 — invariant is param-update-happened, a checksum-equality predicate.

CPU offload: norm_for_param_grads not refreshed after gradient clipping; recorded grad_norm > clipped actual grad_norm. Comparison of two single-rank fields gated on cpu_offload precond. Borderline P1 vs P5: chose P5 because invariant is a magnitude bound on a grad metric.

Inconsistent micro_step_id init (constructor=0 vs backward=-1) breaks copy/accumulate gating in ZeRO-2+offload. Single counter check on a fixed sequence; no cross-rank or module attr precond. Same family as B10. Borderline gradient_sync vs control_flow: chose control_flow per rubric.

link_all_hp_params uses global DP world_size instead of group-specific size; some MoE params end with _hp_mapping=None. Set-completeness 'every trainable param has _hp_mapping' gated on 'param in MoE expert group' precond. Borderline value_equality vs completeness per anti-example 12: completeness.

bf16 optimizer uses wrong DP group for MoE expert params and grad-norm scaling factor off by ep_size. Cross-EP-rank equality on expert grads, gated on 'param is MoE expert' precond. Borderline gradient_sync vs moe: chose moe because root cause is EP-group plumbing, not generic reduction op.

LayerNormBackward1 CUDA kernel uses wrong index pos vs idx for gamma/beta. gamma grad checksum diverges from reference but absolute value looks plausible without reference. Op-level kernel internal — no Tier 0-6 field can detect.

ZeRO-3 reduce stream sync uses default_stream instead of current_stream — produces sporadic NaN partitions due to race. detection_method=source_analysis: occurrence is non-deterministic and hard to attribute to this specific stream sync from runtime trace alone.

Universal checkpoint shard files sorted lexically (10,11,9) instead of numerically — optimizer state silently corrupted. Pre-save vs post-load optimizer state checksum equality gated on 'universal_checkpoint=True' precond. Borderline P7 vs P1: chose P1 — direct value equality on a Tier 4 field.

Same family as D-005: CPUAdam mixes mul vs recompute paths across subgroups producing non-bit-identical bias-correction within same step. Cross-subgroup scalar equality gated on 'same logical step' precond.

After GatheredParameters/checkpoint load, ds_secondary_tensor must equal ds_tensor (post sync) — buggy code leaves stale cache. Two-field equality on the same rank, gated on 'ZeRO++ enabled' precond. Borderline P7 vs P1: chose P1 because the discriminator is direct field-vs-field equality.

Same family as B8: _create_ep_parallel_group called with num_experts not ep_size; created EP group has wrong size. Single value compared to config constant; no module attr precond. Borderline build vs init: chose init — group construction is a runtime initialize() side effect.

MoE grad scaling uses divide=ipg_bucket_has_moe_params truthy, dividing expert grads by bucket count. Expert grad-norm is 1/ep_size of expected. Single-rank magnitude check gated on 'param is MoE expert' precond. Borderline P3 vs P5: chose P5 — magnitude bound, not cross-rank disagreement.

Residual MoE softmax uses dim=1 instead of dim=-1 — coef rows do not sum to 1. detection_method=source_analysis: requires inspecting op-level intermediate softmax output sum, not in Tier 0-6. Single-GPU MoE reproduces so parallel_dim=none.

BF16+ZeRO0: engine all-reduces the bf16 grad even though optimizer accumulates in fp32 buffer — mismatched dtype loses precision. dtype check at all_reduce hook gated on 'bf16_enabled and grad_accum_dtype=fp32' precond. Anti-example 1 dtype family.

scaled_norm_tensor stays on CPU instead of GPU before mixing with CUDA tensors — small numerical drift in MoE+offload+DP>1 norm. detection_method=source_analysis: result diff is tiny, only visible vs non-offload reference run.
ZeRO-3 ignores user-configured comm dtype on allgather/reduce-scatter. dtype consistency check at all_reduce stage gated on 'communication_data_type configured' precond. Same family as B3, D-028.

MoE gate (deepspeed_moe.gate.wg) missing from ZeRO-2 grad-reduce hook tracked set. Set-completeness over tracked params, gated on 'model has MoE gate' precond. Borderline value_equality vs completeness: chose completeness per anti-example 12 — checking a set membership across params.

Multi-machine ZeRO-3 universal checkpoint load yields anomalously high loss instead of resuming. Root cause not pinned to a single observable field; loss-after-resume signal is implementation-equivalence vs save-time which requires reference. Source-only.

bf16+ZeRO0 checkpoint load loses Adam step/exp_avg/exp_avg_sq — counter resets to 0 and momentum buffers zero. Pre-save vs post-load optimizer-state value-equality gated on 'bf16+ZeRO0' precond. Anti-example 7: bug surfaces at load even if root in save logic.

SP scales grad by global world_size instead of SP-then-DP-mean; SP reduce in BF16 loses precision; grad_norm grows over steps. Single-rank magnitude bound gated on 'SP>1' precond. parallel_dim=combo (SP+DP). Borderline P3 vs P5: chose P5 — magnitude/monotonic bound.

ZeRO-3 grad-norm not allreduced across DP — different DP ranks see different global_grad_norm; results disagree with ZeRO-0/1/2. Cross-DP-rank equality on a scalar gated on 'ZeRO-3' precond. Borderline P5 vs P3: chose P3 — bug visible only as cross-rank disagreement.

bf16 optimizer skips grad cast to FP32 when grad_accum_dtype != model dtype. dtype consistency check at before_optimizer gated on 'grad_accum_dtype=fp32 with bf16 model' precond. Anti-example 1 family.

Dominant detectable sub-bug: gate.linear cast to fp32 in forward but param is ZeRO flat-buffer view — gate.weight.dtype changes mid-step. dtype check on gate module gated on 'is MoE gate' precond. Borderline numerical vs moe: chose moe — root cause is MoE-gate plumbing.

Tensor logical_or used on scalar bool results: NaN/inf guard misbehaves so clipping applied to inf-grad turns it NaN. detection_method=source_analysis: subtle behavior change inside scalar-tensor logic; runtime trace would show NaN but cannot pin to this specific cause.

Only changing reduce_bucket_size shifts loss curves and tiny values cause NaN — should be transparent to numerics. No single trace field flags; bug is a scale-dependent numerical instability discovered by sweep, not a runtime invariant. Source/comparison required.

get_start_end_idx ignores batch_len<dp_size*micro_batch_size: some DP ranks get microbatch size 0, breaking averaging weights. Cross-DP-rank equality on microbatch size gated on 'last batch incomplete' precond. Borderline control_flow vs data_loading: chose data_loading — slicing is in dataloader.

ZeRO-3 ckpt directory name (e.g. checkpoint-800) drifts vs internal global_step (799). Two-field equality on same rank — no cross-rank or module attr precond. Borderline P7 vs P1: chose P1 — direct field-vs-field equality on counters.

Coalesced all-gather under autocast mixes dtypes in same op so param state tracking breaks (expected AVAILABLE got inflight). dtype consistency check across params in same all-gather, gated on 'autocast active and ZeRO-3' precond.

MiCS sharding only first partition group saves checkpoint; other groups' data missing. Set-completeness over partition groups, gated on 'MiCS enabled' precond. Borderline value_equality vs completeness per anti-example 12: completeness — checking set, not single value.
Stage3 universal ckpt has tensor slicing OOB and multi-process file race. Race-condition data corruption is non-deterministic and not pinnable to a single trace field; needs source analysis.
ZeRO forces grad_accum buffer dtype = model param dtype; bf16 grad_accum loses precision. dtype check on the grad_accum buffer gated on 'bf16 model and ZeRO enabled' precond. Anti-example 1 family.

TP>1 MoE checkpoint only saves rank 0's mp_rank_00_model_states.pt; other TP rank files missing. Set-completeness over TP-rank-saved files, gated on 'TP>1 with MoE' precond. Borderline value_equality vs completeness: completeness per anti-example 12.

copy_grads_in_partition only accumulates when ga_steps>1, missing micro_step_id>0 case in manual GA — CPU buf underestimates norm. Grad_norm trend gated on 'cpu_offload, ga_steps==1' precond. Borderline optimizer_state vs offload: chose offload — root cause is cpu-offload gating.

WarmupCosineLR multi-group init: get_lr returns [0.0] instead of one entry per group. Set-length completeness check on lr list vs num param groups; no cross-rank or module attr precond. Borderline value_equality vs completeness: completeness — set/length check.

_take_model_step hits 'pass' branch for bf16+ZeRO0 so zero_grad never called; grads accumulate forever. Single-rank grad_norm at step start should equal 0 if pre-backward — gated on 'bf16+ZeRO0' precond. Borderline P1 vs P5: chose P5 — magnitude/monotonic bound across steps.

Same family as D-021: ZeRO-3 reduce_and_partition_stream syncs against default_stream not current_stream — sporadic NaN partitions due to race. Non-deterministic, not pinnable to a single trace field; source-only.

Loss double-scaling: scale_if_loss applied to gas_scaled_loss in backward. Bug is a duplicated multiplication; loss value alone looks plausible without reference run. No Tier 0-6 trace field discriminates. Source-only by inspection.

ZeRO-1/2 CPU-offload loses grads when multiple backward() per step. Same family as D-010/D-012/D-NEW-13: grad_norm trend over microsteps gated on cpu_offload precond reveals underaccumulation. Borderline gradient_sync vs offload: chose offload — gating logic specific to offload path.

extra_large_param uses param.dtype not comm_dtype for gradient comm — silently dropped/wrong-dtype grad. dtype check at all_reduce gated on 'extra_large_param path active' precond. Same family as D-028, D-030. Borderline gradient_sync vs dtype: dtype is the root cause.

BF16_Optimizer wrongly selected for bf16+fp32_grad_accum without ZeRO. Single-rank check that the actually instantiated optimizer class matches the expected dispatch given config; no cross-rank or module attr precond. Borderline P4 vs P7: chose P7 — checking module class flag, not dtype/shape.

ZeRO-1/2 elastic ckpt re-flatten alignment ignores nccl_start_alignment_factor*world_size padding used at save. Pre-save vs post-load optimizer.state[p] equality, gated on 'elastic load with different world size' precond. Borderline P7 vs P1: chose P1 — direct value equality on Tier 4 fields.

ZeRO-2 allreduce_bucket hard-resets rank=None — single-rank-reduce path never taken. Expected dist op name (dist.reduce vs dist.all_reduce) gated on use_multi_rank_bucket_allreduce=False precond. Borderline P6 vs P7: chose P7 — op-call counter, not group-size config.

ZeRO-3 contiguous_gradients off-by-one: param exactly filling bucket dropped from reduce. Grad-zero-after-backward when expected non-zero, gated on 'param.numel==bucket free space' precond. Borderline P3 vs P5: chose P5 — single-rank zero/non-zero check, not cross-rank.

load_module_only with bf16 skips refresh_fp32_params (guarded by fp16_enabled), so fp32 master weights remain default-init. Field equality fp32_groups_flat[i] == bf16_groups_flat[i].float() gated on 'bf16 and load_module_only=True and load_optimizer_states=False' precond.

Copy-paste typo in zero.Init.__init__ assigns to self.quantized_weights instead of self.quantized_nontrainable_weights. Single-rank attr-vs-config equality; no cross-rank or other module attr precond. Borderline P4 vs P7: chose P7 — counter/flag attr value, not dtype/shape.

__avg_scatter_contiguous_grads inverted gate: cast happens only when no cast needed, so reduce-scatter runs in wrong dtype. dtype check at all_reduce stage gated on 'communication_data_type != model dtype' precond. Anti-example 1 dtype family.

Two related bugs: bf16 wrapper picked even with cpu_offload; extra_large_param uses raw param.grad instead of get_gradient_for_reduction. dtype/object identity check on reduction tensor gated on 'use_grad_accum_for_reduction=True and extra_large_param path' precond.

fp32->fp16 master-weight copy uses outer-loop partition_id; MoE groups have different real_dp_process_group ranks so wrong slice updated. Cross-rank/group equality gated on 'MoE EP group != DP group' precond. Borderline sharding vs moe: chose moe — root cause is MoE group mismatch.

Optimizer groups must contain only requires_grad=True params; bug includes frozen ones. Set-membership check across params; no cross-rank or other module attr precond. Borderline value_equality vs completeness per anti-example 12: completeness — set check.

Same as D-NEW-29 but in DeepSpeedCPUAdam path: outer partition_id used across groups so non-first groups receive wrong rank's partition. Cross-rank/group equality gated on 'multiple groups with different real_dp_process_group' precond. Borderline moe vs offload: chose offload — bug in CPU-Adam.

param_to_partition_ids built from fp16_groups but reduction uses round_robin_fp16_groups — owner mismatches reducer; some grads never reach optimizer. Two-table consistency gated on 'round_robin_gradients=True' precond. Borderline P3 vs P7: chose P7 — flag/index mapping check.

partition_balanced returns degenerate boundaries [0,2,4,5,5] for 5/4 — last stage owns 0 layers. Static assertion at build time on the boundary list satisfies P8 (module-class enumeration). Borderline P7 vs P8: chose P8 — directly assertable on named_modules at build, no runtime hook.

MiCS: save_non_zero_checkpoint True on every rank — racing writes to same file. Set-cardinality check 'exactly mics_shard_size ranks have save_non_zero_checkpoint=True' gated on 'MiCS enabled' precond. Borderline value_equality vs completeness: completeness — set-size check across ranks.

all_gather_coalesced builds one flat partition buffer assuming single ds_tensor dtype across the group; mixed-dtype params get bytes truncated/aliased. dtype consistency check across params in same allgather, gated on 'param group has mixed floating dtypes' precond. Same family as D-042.

Train/eval coordinators share same InflightParamRegistry instance — inflight handles cross-fire on mode switch. id() inequality between two coordinators gated on 'ZeRO-3 with overlap_comm/prefetch' precond. Borderline P4 vs P7: P7 — flag/object check, not dtype/shape.

ZeRO step unscales grad-norm by post-decay loss_scale instead of prev_scale used during backward. Equality scaled_norm == norm * prev_scale gated on 'fp16 dynamic loss scaling, scale just halved' precond. Borderline P1 vs P5: chose P5 — grad-norm/scale invariant.

SparseTensor wraps param.grad.data into local var never written back; param.grad keeps pre-allreduce value. Value-equality check post-allreduce gated on 'param.grad is sparse' precond. Borderline data_loading vs gradient_sync: chose data_loading — root cause is sparse-embedding plumbing.

_aggregate_total_loss broadcasts bf16 stack but other PP ranks pre-allocate fp32 receive buffers — bytes silently misinterpreted. Cross-PP-rank dtype equality on losses tensor, gated on 'bf16 model and PP>1' precond.

zero_wrapper rebinds local 'tensor' after .to(target_fp_dtype) but model still holds original Parameter — model param keeps wrong dtype. dtype check on the model-visible param gated on 'inside zero.Init context' precond.

ZeRO-3 _create_fp16_partitions includes frozen params, then Adam updates them — silently un-frozen. Pre/post-step param-checksum equality gated on 'requires_grad=False' precond. Borderline P3 vs P7: chose P7 — flag-driven equality, not cross-rank.

Backward hook closure late-binds loop var i; all hooks fire with last group index, routing earlier grads to wrong bucket. Equality 'hook bucket_id == param's group index' gated on 'multiple param groups, ZeRO-3' precond. Borderline P3 vs P7: chose P7 — index routing check.

ZeRO/BF16 wrappers eagerly call inner optimizer.step() during init to materialize state, incrementing Adam state['step'] before any real update — bias-correction off by one for first step. Equality optimizer.state[p]['step']==0 after deepspeed.initialize; no cross-rank or precond.
